description: This file defines the LeaveBalance class in the OrangeHRM system, representing the leave entitlement and usage details for an employee's leave balance management. It includes properties for entitled leave, used, scheduled, pending, taken leaves, and methods to compute and access the leave balance as of a specific date.

classes.name: LeaveBalance
classes.description: Represents an employee's leave balance including entitlement, used, scheduled, pending, taken leaves, and computes current balance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes leave balance properties with optional custom values.

methods.name: updateBalance
methods.description: Calculates and updates the current leave balance considering entitlement, scheduled, taken, and optionally pending leaves.

methods.name: getAsAtDate
methods.description: Get the date for which the leave balance is calculated.

methods.name: getYmdAsAtDate
methods.description: Return the AsAtDate in YMD string format.

methods.name: setAsAtDate
methods.description: Set the date for leave balance calculation.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Get the end date of the leave balance period.

methods.name: getYmdEndDate
methods.description: Return the end date in YMD string format.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Set the end date of the leave balance period.
